answers.how: Fitting the shark’s horizontal positions to accelerated motion gives an initial speed of about 76 px/s and acceleration of 38 px/s². The given acceleration sets the scale to about 38 px/m.
The boat moves approximately 191 px in one second. Dividing by the shark-derived scale of about 38 px/m gives its speed.
The fully visible boat spans approximately 382 px horizontally, equivalent to about 10 m at the shark-derived scale.
The shark spans approximately 123 px from nose to tail. Using about 38 px/m gives its length.
The shark’s vertical extent, including fins, is approximately 46 px. Using about 38 px/m gives its height.
